)

nodes.notes: A rep manually adding a contact isn't a lead form submission — no thank-you email. Only fires the (separate, trigger_event-driven) 'Contact Added Manually' template, and only while the contact is still lead_status = New (an admin adding an existing Customer/etc. shouldn't get a cold-outreach-style email).
